actual_scope: Exact single-ADD/SCALE omission observability census of the selected complex k8 R480 scalar program in both orientations, with source-bound rejection of data-invisible arbitrary-dirty-helper faults.
scope_change_reason: The historical owner timing omission is not a current bug. This audits the current all-column scalar endpoint obligation rather than repeating owner, chart-phase or helper-endpoint audits.
bottleneck_link: Independent reliability evidence for the binding complex supplier: quantifies why target-only or clean-helper testing cannot replace its complete dirty-state endpoint check. No profile or kappa improvement is claimed.
stop_rule: Complete all 19669 single scalar-event omissions per orientation, two literal production-checker adversaries, small exact oracle controls, and source/caller binding; no multi-fault search or full cold replay.

open_questions.question: What small fixed rational probe set detects every single selected scalar-event omission with all outputs observed?
open_questions.why_it_matters: A bounded diagnostic could complement, not replace, the exact all-column admission; clean-helper probes provably miss 8977 forward faults.
open_questions.first_step: Collect the exact prefix source covectors already hashed here and seek a probe avoiding all their kernels, then replay every selected mutant on that probe.
open_questions.blocked_by: No probe size, coefficient-height bound or practical cost advantage is established here; multiple faults and physical/native admission remain separate.
